importance_ranking.reason: FRP security cabins vary significantly in visual appearance by size class, roof style (flat vs pyramid vs Manglori tile), colour, and build quality — buyers use the image to identify the right product type before reading any text. Wrong visual type causes an immediate skip.

Footprint dimensions are a hard physical constraint — a 4x4 ft cabin cannot substitute for a 6x6 ft. Built type (standard vs insulated PUF vs Manglori) drives both price tier and climate suitability, making specs the primary shortlisting gate after image confirmation.

Price varies substantially with dimensions and built type — Indian buyers compare prices aggressively across sellers once size and construction type are confirmed. Price is a decisive shortlisting signal in this commoditised mid-market category.

importance_ranking.brand_important_reason: No dominant brand with buyer recall exists in this category — the market is fragmented across regional FRP fabricators in Pune, Gujarat, and Maharashtra; buyers search by spec and price, not manufacturer name.
importance_ranking.reason: Seller credibility matters for installation support, delivery reach, and after-sales service, but company identity is evaluated after spec and price shortlisting — not as a primary engagement signal.

importance_ranking.unit_note: Custom large-format cabins (site office, forest office) are occasionally quoted per sq ft by some manufacturers, but the dominant market unit is per piece for all standard catalogue sizes.
importance_ranking.reason: FRP security cabins are complete prefabricated units — no buyer ever questions whether the unit is per piece. Unit is entirely implied by the product.

top_configurator_specs.reason: Footprint dimensions are non-interchangeable across buyer requirements and are the single largest price driver — price scales directly with floor area across all size variants.

Standard vs Insulated (PUF Core) vs Manglori Design represents a significant price delta and non-interchangeable construction quality tier — insulated PUF commands a substantial premium and serves different climate requirements than standard FRP.

missing_important_specs.why_important: Buyers — particularly housing societies and commercial premises — specify exterior colour to match site aesthetics, and manufacturers offer standard colour options (cream, grey, green, blue); colour is a configurable option on all major FRP cabin manufacturer sites.

top_rfq_specs.reason: Footprint dimensions are the primary hard constraint — sellers need the floor area to confirm they can supply the right size and to price the unit accurately.
Seating capacity communicates the operational requirement in buyer-intuitive terms, helping sellers recommend the correct size class and confirm fit for single-person vs multi-person guard posts.

missing_important_specs.why_important: Sellers who manufacture only standard FRP cannot supply insulated PUF core cabins — buyers must specify construction type so sellers can confirm eligibility and price the correct tier.
Flat, pyramid, and Manglori tile roofs require different fabrication capabilities — sellers need the roof type to confirm they can supply the requested design and to price accurately.
